adminSettings.title: System Settings
adminSettings.subtitle: Manage site information, technical limits, security policies, and cache.
adminSettings.defaultDescription: Yet another self-hosted Utopia Images service
adminSettings.baseUrlTip: Supports configuring multiple domains (one per line or comma-separated). Multiple domains will be used for Passkey authentication and dynamic link generation.
adminSettings.restrictDomains: Restrict Image Access to Configured Domains Only
adminSettings.restrictDomainsDesc: Reject image access requests made through unconfigured domains with 401 Unauthorized
adminSettings.restrictDomainsTip: When enabled, direct links and derived image access will only be served through domains listed in External Base URL above. Admin console and APIs are not affected. Default is off.
adminSettings.maxFileSizeTip: Uploads exceeding this size will be rejected by the server
adminSettings.maxProcessSizeTip: Images exceeding this size will skip heavy rendering
adminSettings.enableFormatConversionTip: Allow clients to request on-demand converted modern formats such as WebP
adminSettings.force2faTip: All users must configure two-factor authentication before using the system
adminSettings.enableHotlinkTip: Only allow whitelisted referrer domains to embed images
adminSettings.allowEmptyRefererTip: Allow direct address bar visits and requests without Referer
adminSettings.allowedDomainsPlaceholder: Support wildcard domains like *.example.com, one per line or comma separated
adminSettings.cacheDesc: Thumbnails, watermarked images, and WebP converted images are cached on disk for accelerated delivery.
adminSettings.cacheMaxSizeTip: In MB, enter 0 for unlimited. Oldest cache files are pruned when capacity limit is reached.
adminSettings.cacheTTLTip: In days, enter 0 for unlimited (keep forever). Expired files will be automatically pruned.
adminSettings.cdnCacheControlDesc: Add Cache-Control: no-cache header to all image responses
adminSettings.cdnCacheControlTip: Forces clients and CDN edges to revalidate with the origin for accurate access call statistics
adminSettings.cdnNoticeContent: CDN Cache Control has been enabled. All image responses will include 'Cache-Control: no-cache'. Notice: If your CDN provider (such as Cloudflare) ignores Cache-Control headers by default, you must configure a Cache Bypass rule in your CDN console for this domain; otherwise CDN edge caching will prevent visits from being counted by the origin.
adminSettings.confirmClearCache: Are you sure you want to clear the derived cache? Files will be regenerated on demand.
adminSettings.loggingDesc: Configure layered logging severity and rolling disk retention policy for auditing and diagnosing system status.
adminSettings.logLevelTip: DEBUG records raw SQL and tracing; INFO logs normal traffic; WARN logs slow queries and warnings; ERROR only logs failures
adminSettings.logPermanentLevelTip: Logs matching or exceeding this level will be permanently saved to disk without rotation or deletion
adminSettings.logMaxSizeTip: Log files will rotate and compress into archives when reaching this size threshold
adminSettings.logMaxBackupsTip: Oldest log archives exceeding this limit will be automatically rotated out
adminSettings.logMaxAgeTip: Archives older than this number of days will be deleted automatically
adminSettings.allowRegistrationTip: When enabled, visitors can register accounts from the login page
adminSettings.defaultRegisterRoleTip: The initial role and storage quota automatically assigned to newly registered users
adminSettings.smtpDesc: Configure SMTP service for user registration activation and password recovery.
adminSettings.smtpOptionalTip: SMTP service is required if user registration is enabled.
